name: frappe-assets
description: Shared front-end toolkit and snippets for Frappe apps
//sideEffects: The toolkit is pure — every module earns its place by being imported for an export, so a consuming bundler may drop whatever a dashboard does not use. `demo/` is the exception and must be listed: `gallery.js` pulls in `frappe-stub.js` as a bare import for its side effects alone, and under a blanket `false` esbuild removes that import and the gallery dies on the first `__()`.
//devDependencies: Gallery build only. Yarn does not install a git dependency's devDependencies, so none of this reaches a consuming app. The script is named `demo` and not `prepare` for the same reason: yarn runs `prepare` for git deps, and every app installing this would start building the gallery.
